plain.li: [story:FearLaid,stage:0] Everyone keeps telling me it's over.
[story:FearLaid,stage:0,captured] I don't go down to the cells, not while {NAME} is there.
[story:FearLaid,stage:0,dead] {NAME} is dead, so why am I still checking the doors?
[story:FearLaid,stage:1] There's something about {NAME} I've never told anyone.
[story:FearLaid,stage:2] I told it all, start to finish, and I'm still standing.
[story:FearLaid,stage:2] I slept a little better last night.
